history.summary: A 1,410 sqft 4BR at Hilbre28, a small 999-year-tenure D19 (Serangoon/Kovan fringe) development, at $2.3M / $1,631 psf. Near-freehold tenure is a plus, but only 9 URA txns makes the 4.3%/yr rate unreliable and the boutique scale limits liquidity.
history.rating_rationale: 999-year tenure (effectively freehold) and a reasonable $2.3M quantum at $1,631 psf vs a $1,649 median are the positives. But the appreciation rate rests on just 9 transactions — statistically unreliable, so the 4.3%/yr can't be trusted. Hilbre28 is a small boutique development (~69 units) with no MRT listed in the dossier, meaning shallow resale liquidity and limited amenities. A 4BR in a niche small dev is a hard, family-only resale.
red_flags: Only 9 URA txns — appreciation rate unreliable
Small boutique development — thin liquidity, limited facilities
No MRT proximity listed; 4BR niche family-only resale
catalysts: Listing roughly at project median PSF (fairly priced)
D19 broad growth story (PDD/CRL) in the wider region
